# ERRATA*** (24 · errata)

An anti-design laboratory — draggable windows, a button you shouldn’t click, calibrated chaos.

- **Technique:** ANTI-DESIGN
- **Tags:** anti-design, experimental, chaotic, brutalist, playful, windows, art
- **Best for:** experimental agencies; art projects; personal sites
- **Fonts:** Rubik Mono One, Courier Prime, Archivo
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Rubik+Mono+One&family=Courier+Prime:ital@0;1&family=Archivo:wght@400;700&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #f2f0ea · #e03616 · #1133cc
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/errata/` (Template.astro, content.ts, desk.ts, meta.ts, style.css, theme.css, trail.ts)

## Tokens — `theme.css`
Every color and font stack the design uses. Override per site; canvas/WebGL effects read these at init.

```css

  --off: #f2f0ea;
  --blk: #141414;
  --red: #e03616;
  --blue: #1133cc;
  --chart: #d8e83a;
  --white: #fff;
  --mute: #777;
  --rule: #ccc;
  --mono1: "Rubik Mono One", monospace;

  --serif: Times, serif;

```

## Signature effects
- `desk.ts`
  - `initDesk(desk: HTMLElement)` — Hero desk behaviour: draggable windows (`[data-drag]`, dragged by their `.bar`), close boxes (`[data-x]`), and the DO NOT CLICK button (`#donot`) that spawns more windows and counts them in `#spawnCount`.
- `trail.ts`
  - `initCursorTrail(glyph: string)` — Fading glyph trail behind the cursor (fine pointers only, off under reduced motion).

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<i>/<u>/<mark>/<span>/<br>/<a> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Where a draggable window sits in the hero desk. Lengths are CSS values. Collapsed to a stack on mobile. */
export interface Placement {
  left?: string;
  right?: string;
  top?: string;
  bottom?: string;
  maxWidth: string;
  /** Initial stacking order. */
  z: number;
  /** Tilt in degrees. */
  rotate?: number;
}

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Logo in nav + footer, e.g. `ERRATA<i>***</i>` (the <i> is red). */
  wordmarkHtml: string;
  nav: {
    /** Text scrolling along the top bar; repeated to fill the width. */
    ticker: string;
    links: Link[];
  };
  desk: {
    /** Glyph on every window's close box. */
    closeGlyph: string;
    /** Glyph that trails the cursor on fine-pointer devices. */
    trailGlyph: string;
    /** Bottom hint bar (desktop only). */
    hintHtml: string;
    manifesto: {
      title: string;
      placement: Placement;
      headingHtml: string;
      text: string;
      stamp: string;
    };
    evidence: {
      title: string;
      placement: Placement;
      /** Caption above the drawing. */
      caption: string;
    };
    doNot: {
      title: string;
      placement: Placement;
      lead: string;
      button: string;
      /** Shown as `(${counterLabel} N)`. */
      counterLabel: string;
    };
    quote: {
      title: string;
      placement: Placement;
      quoteHtml: string;
    };
    /** Windows spawned by the button. Title/body cycle by click number. */
    spawn: {
      titles: string[];
      bodies: string[];
      /** Click number that also raises the "intervention" window. */
      interventionAt: number;
      intervention: { title: string; heading: string; text: string };
    };
  };
  rules: {
    headingHtml: string;
    /** Numbered 1…n automatically. */
    rants: { html: string }[];
  };
  specimen: {
    headingHtml: string;
    /** Tag pinned to the box's corner. */
    note: string;
    /** Up to four lines, each set in its own typeface. */
    lines: string[];
  };
  footer: {
    noteHtml: string;
    creditHtml: string;
  };
  /** Showcase-only chrome; rendered when the template's `showcase` prop is true. */
  showcase?: {
    chipLabel: string;
    chipHref: string;
    footerHtml: string;
  };
}
```

- Full site: `node <skill-dir>/scripts/weft.mjs template errata --out <dir>`
- Style kit for an existing project: `node <skill-dir>/scripts/weft.mjs style errata --out <dir>`
